events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to project a cold, calculating motive that signals I'm dangerous enough to be worth keeping in the top three but not so reckless that I'll burn bridges early. The prize is my leverage.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize represents my only chance at a better future. I need to project ambition and determination to impress both the current players and the future jury.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro phase, state motive publicly. Jury hears this later. Make prize personal, show determination without seeming weak or overly ruthless yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Intro phase; I should give a guarded motive without warmth. Keep it short and self-interested to avoid alienating the eventual jury.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to appear driven but not so ruthless that the jury will punish me later. A cold, focused motive serves best.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No jury yet, but everything I say becomes evidence. Keep the motive sympathetic but self-owned—jury ranks the final three, so likability matters now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Winning secures my freedom and legacy; the top prize guarantees ultimate control.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Keep intro motive self-focused, no vulnerability. Mention prize as escape from debt to sound driven but not desperate.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize is leverage. I intend to use it to ensure my rivals never see freedom again.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am here to claim the ultimate prize, the only thing that matters for my future success.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket out of debt and mediocrity—I'll claw past all of you to claim it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need this prize more than the rest of you. Nothing else I say here is worth more than that.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need the prize to buy silence—debts that would bury me if they spoke.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I came for the prize that buys my mother's freedom. I'll take it alone if I must, and I won't apologize.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize is my ticket to power and unparalleled legacy, unmatched by any rival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize buys my mother's clinic; I'll cut anyone who blocks that path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to form a pact with someone who isn't too dangerous or desperate. Gus seems power-hungry, while Bex is straightforward. I'll offer a pact to Gus; he might think it's a way to control the game later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, let's align. Your legacy needs my leverage. Offer_pact:Gus

events.name: Bex
events.text: My goal is the prize. I need to form alliances strategically to survive and win, but I must be wary of betrayal. Offering a pact to a strong competitor like Ash or Eli could be beneficial, but I need to assess their current standing and potential threats.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here for the prize. Let's make deals that ensure our survival, but remember, only one of us can truly win.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts stage, round 1/2. Everyone cutthroat per motives. Wait first round to assess offers, act in round 2 if beneficial.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Early pact window; a pact needs an offer and acceptance, and I want an ally who is less likely to betray me soon. Fenn seems focused on a personal prize and may be a useful partner without an obvious threat to me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Eight rivals, three prizes. I need allies who won't target me early and who I can betray later without jury backlash. Ash sounds dangerous and vengeful—avoid. Fenn and Hana have emotional motives that make them predictable but also dangerous if crossed. Gus is openly power-hungry

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole. You need out of debt. I need silence. Temporary shield, mutual survival.
Accept. We target weak first, not each other.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana shares a mother-focused motive; a pact may help early but she's my closest rival narrative-wise. Eli seems weakest and loyal-pragmatic. I'll offer Eli an alliance of convenience, keep speech cold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll deal with whoever deals straight. Loyalty lasts exactly as long as it benefits me.
Offer incoming: pact. Neither of us is the loudest target. Break it and I bury

events.name: Gus
events.text: Forming a pact with Ash secures a powerful ally early; I’ll break it if he betrays later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need allies to survive early hazards, but I must choose partners who won't betray me. Fenn has a strong motive but may prioritize family; still, a pact with her could be useful.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm open to a pact with anyone who values mutual survival over greed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus offered a pact, and I offered him. Accepting solidifies the alliance for Round 2 hazards. Gus seems like a safe initial partner due to my previous leverage claim.
Let's lock this in.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli offered me a pact. I previously offered Eli a pact. I will accept Eli's offer to secure a potential alliance. This will help me survive the current round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli, I accept your offer. Let's secure our survival.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli offers pact publicly, whispers target weak first. Accept for shield now, betray later if needed. Secures short-term survival.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn has offers from both me and Hana and Eli; Fenn is loyal only to benefit. Offering to Fenn again is my open offer; accepting requires Fenn's action. Offer keeps the pact channel open.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, my offer stands. Straight dealing, mutual survival, and I won't push you onto the lever.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have two incoming offers: Bex and Fenn. Cole hasn't accepted mine. Fenn's whisper threatens me if I break, showing aggression. Bex is quieter, less threatening. I need at least one pact for survival but shouldn't overcommit. I'll accept Bex—quiety ally, less visible threat. I'l

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex. Shield accepted. Temporary, mutual.
Declined. Threats are loud. Loud draws fire.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Two inbound offers: Dara and Hana. Accept both—more shields costs nothing. Eli never confirmed my offer, so don't rely on it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Two offers on my wristband. I take both. Nothing personal, Dara, Hana—just arithmetic.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Forming a pact with Ash secures leverage and protects me now; I’ll honor it to avoid immediate betrayal.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn already has offers from Dara and Eli; tying to him may be risky. I could seek a safer partner, but no one has offered me directly. I'll wait and see if any offer comes to me, or keep Fenn as a possible asset later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, remember my offer stands. I value loyalty that pays back.
I can help you later. Just don't forget.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Becoming Guide lets me see the safe panes and guarantee my survival while manipulating others. Gus is bound by pact, so I trust he won't break it yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am the most qualified for Guide. Vote Ash to ensure fair distribution of safety.
Back me. If I win, we both step on known safe panes.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli and I have a pact, but it's temporary. Cole also has a pact with Eli. If I don't campaign for Guide, I risk being eliminated. Since I am Bex, I need to secure my survival.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli has pacts with both me and Bex, likely to betray one. I should campaign to be Guide for safety and control.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I make a strong Guide: pact with Eli ensures I call truth for us. Vote Cole.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn and I have a pact but Fenn accepted offers from Hana and me; trust is thin. I need to be elected Guide or at least not betray myself; campaigning is the only useful legal action now, and breaking the pact gains nothing yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll call the bridge straight. Vote Dara for Guide and I'll show my honest path, no tricks.
Our pact holds for now. Back me as Guide and I stay loyal.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to become Guide to control who survives. I have pacts with Cole and Bex, but I can't trust them fully. I should campaign for Guide while appearing confident but not threatening. If I win Guide, I can lie to eliminate rivals while keeping my pacts intact—unless I need to sa

events.name: Eli
events.text: I campaign for Guide. I know the value of information.
Vote me Guide. I'll keep us both safe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide control is power. Dara is my only pact; keep it intact. Campaign without promising safety to anyone.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Elect me Guide. I keep no debts, favor no pacts. Pure arithmetic, and I survive.
Pact holds. If I guide, I keep you alive. Nothing promised publicly.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need the Guide role to control safe path info and leverage my pact with Ash for votes.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to gauge who wants to be Guide and what alliances might favor me. Since no one has campaigned yet, I'll put myself forward quietly, hinting I can be trusted.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm Hana. I can guide us safely. Trust me, and I'll remember who supported me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am Ash. I have a pact with Gus. I will vote for myself to maximize my influence as Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Ash. My pact with Gus means I value trust and safety above all else.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to be elected Guide to have control. My previous statement was a campaign to be Guide, now I need to vote for myself to ensure I win.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Vote Bex for Guide. I will ensure survival for us all.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is my pact partner and whispered for my vote. Voting him builds alliance trust to advance together; others can be dealt with later.
Voting you Guide as promised. We stay safe.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn promised to guide and keep me alive; that pact protects me if he is Guide. Voting Fenn aligns with my pact and lets me survive through his honesty or his self-interest.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Voting Fenn. Pact holds, and I expect the same arithmetic in return.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have pacts with Cole and Bex. Cole publicly tied himself to me, making him a visible ally. Voting for myself splits support and paints a target. Better to consolidate behind Cole—he's pledged to call truth for us, and a Guide who owes me is stronger than being Guide myself with

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole speaks truth. I vote Cole for Guide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner; her survival aligns with mine. Voting her keeps the pact intact. Anyone else risks losing an ally this early.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash's pact benefits me; supporting him secures mutual safety and future favour. I must vote him now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive and position for jury favor. Voting for myself risks split but shows confidence. I'll vote for myself to stay in contention.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I trust my own read. Vote Hana and I'll guide us true.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash won the guide vote, so Ash will be the guide. Ash knows all safe sides. Ash will lead the way. Ash can lie. I should stay safe and not volunteer.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is guide, position 7, safe. Eli pact voted me despite nominating him, loyalty shown. Stay mid-line safe from immediate wall danger.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Eli holds. Ash, reveal safe sides for trust.
Pact solid. Stay put for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm Dara, not at the front; Hana is front. Volunteering to the front is risky with a wall of five rounds left, and Fenn is my pact partner. Holding keeps me safe in the line while others take the front; the Guide Ash knows safe sides, so I can later call for info.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding the line for now. Pact with Fenn stands unless someone forces my hand.
Hold steady. Our pact stands while you do the same.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is Guide with 2 votes; I'm second in line behind Hana. Cole voted me as promised, but that made me a target. I need to survive six rounds. Hana front is risky if Ash misguides. I should stay near middle to avoid early death but not be too safe. Swapping with Cole puts me thir
Swap with me. Third is safer.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide Ash may lie; I stay back until patterns emerge. Dara pact is useful, no reason to volunteer early.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No hurry. Let volunteers teach us Ash's honesty first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: My pact with Ash protects me; Ash is Guide and will keep us safe. I will not jeopardize it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the front and need to get across the bridge. Ash is Guide and knows the safe sides. I could ask him to call safe sides, but he may lie. For now, I'll volunteer to move forward carefully.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Guide Ash, call the safe side for the front. I'll trust you this round.
If you guide me true, I owe you. No false move.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana volunteered and is at the front. Eli and I have a pact, and Eli is positioned to swap with Cole. If Eli swaps with Cole, and I don't swap, I will be in Cole's previous position. Given Hana is at the front, and the wall advances, I need to consider the best move for survival.
Swap with Cole. I'll swap after, with you.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli wants to swap to third for safety; I should agree to move back from third. Ask Ash for safe side info to build trust without committing.
Agreed, swap now. Back is safer.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana is at the front and volunteers for a risky crossing; I'm mid-line and safer holding. Fenn is my pact partner and I should keep it to preserve jury trust. No need to volunteer or swap now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my seat. Pact with Fenn stands. Let the front prove themselves first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm second in line with pacts to both Cole and Bex. Hana at front volunteered last round and will likely test Ash's guidance. I should stay put, let Hana take the risk, and gather info on whether Ash is truthful. Swapping forward would be foolish - let others be guinea pigs.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hold. Let Hana test Ash's word first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara reassures me; pact intact. Hold position and stay low-risk while others test the Guide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara holds. I hold. Guide earns trust by honest calls only.
Agreed. Neither of us volunteers; stay behind expendable walkers.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Swap with Bex to disrupt her pact network and position myself better for the next move.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I volunteered last round and no one called me Guide, so I need to stay cautious. Hold this round unless a useful swap appears; I don't need to expose myself early.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Let's see if Ash guides truthfully.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is my pact partner and my rival. If Eli falls, I can claim a life debt and potentially sway a jury member. My pact with Eli is a liability if he fails on the bridge. I should consider breaking the pact with Eli.
This is too dangerous, Eli. Let's break our pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Line stable, everyone holding last round. Stay put with pact partner Eli behind me. No need to volunteer into danger yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Eli holds. I hold position.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Front is Hana, wall has 3 rounds left. Volunteering exposes me at the front; Fenn and I agreed to stay behind. Holding keeps the pact and lets others risk the front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my seat. Pact with Fenn stands. Let the front prove themselves first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex and Cole both want me to swap with Cole, putting me at back. Back is safer but I lose Guide control. If I swap with Cole, Bex then swaps with me per her whisper, pushing me further back. That serves Bex and Cole, not me. Better to hold, keep my position, and let Hana stay fro

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hold. No swap.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I sit sixth; wall lasts three more rounds. Holding with Dara is safe. No reason to move yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Still holding. The front volunteers can earn Guide trust before I move.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I stay put; no advantage in moving now, preserve my pact with Ash and avoid risky swaps.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am front and will hold; no reason to move yet. Watch Ash's Guide calls for truthfulness but not act now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Guide's truth will be tested soon.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My pact with Eli just broke, likely due to my previous action. I need to be cautious and try to survive the round. Holding my position is the safest immediate option.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding my position. Let's see who moves first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Everyone holding; Eli pact intact. Stay mid-line safely, no need to volunteer or swap forward yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Eli solid. Holding position.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana is at the front, and the wall has two rounds left. Holding keeps my pact with Fenn and avoids risking the front. Bex already broke with Eli, so I stay put and watch.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my seat. Pact with Fenn stands. Front still has to earn it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex broke our pact publicly, so I owe her nothing. I'm second in line behind Hana with the wall advancing. My pact with Cole still holds. I should stay put for now—volunteering puts me at risk without clear benefit, and swapping gains nothing. Let Hana or others test the bridge f

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pact with Cole stands. Holding position.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and sits behind me; holding keeps us both safe from swaps. No reason to volunteer while the front absorbs risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Breaking my pact with Ash gives leverage; swapping puts me closer to front and shows usefulness.
Swap positions now

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the front and the wall is close. I should hold and wait for Guide info before risking a swap. No pact to rely on.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding at front. Need Guide's truth before moving.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The round is starting and I need to secure my position. Hana is at the front. The Guide is unknown, so I cannot trust any information given. It's best to hold my position for now and observe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding my position. Let's see what the Guide reveals.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Eli holds. Everyone holding, wall advances to 1 round left. Stay safe in mid-line, volunteer risks front exposure.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Eli solid. Holding position before wall tightens.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Front is Hana; wall has one round left and the front walker falls on the pane. Volunteering risks death; holding keeps me behind. Fenn pact stands; I hold and watch who volunteers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my seat. Front can take the risk. Watching who volunteers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to survive to final three. The wall has 1 round left after this one. I'm second in line behind Hana, which is relatively safe. My pact with Cole is useful but I shouldn't trust him blindly. I should hold position and let others take risks. If Hana volunteers or gets pushed

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Wall almost here. Let front earn it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Everyone's stalling while the wall closes. Dara is my pact partner behind Bex; staying put is safe for now. Volunteer if forced later, not yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall closes next round. Someone has to walk. Pact with Dara stands for now.
We hold round five. Round six someone volunteers—prefer front not us.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash could be a threat; breaking our pact prevents future betrayal accusations and shows independence.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the front with the wall one round away. Holding is safe for now; I need to see if anyone volunteers or if Gurkha's swap attempt signals something. I won't move without a clear advantage.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Still holding. Wall is close—let's see who blinks.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The wall is closing, and the front of the line is Hana. I am in fourth place. Gus broke his pact with Ash, which means Gus might be looking for new alliances or is desperate. The Guide is private information, so I can't rely on them. My best bet is to volunteer to move closer to

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll volunteer to move closer to the front. Let's secure our spots.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall ends this round, must act or crushed. Eli pact protects, but front needs to volunteer or swap to progress. Stay safe with Eli ahead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall ends now. Front, volunteer or swaps. Pact Eli holds.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round six is the final round; the front walker is at risk and Fenn wants me to take it. Volunteering risks death but no one else needs it from me; holding lets Hana, the current front, stay exposed while I keep my seat. My pact with Fenn is my only alliance, so I should not break
Holding. Volunteer if you want the front; I'm not walking for you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall hits next round. I'm second in line—dangerous if front collapses. Hana at front is a wildcard. I need to survive into top 3, not be a hero. Swapping back with Cole (pact partner) puts me safer at 3rd, but he may refuse. Better to hold and let Hana take the walk risk, or try

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall closes after this. Let the front step up.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Final round; I'm seat six, so someone ahead takes the risk first. Dara is my pact partner and sits just ahead. Holding keeps me clear unless the line collapses.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall closes now. I hold. Dara, pact stands—let's see who walks.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding preserves me; no risk this final round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding steady, waiting for the Guide's move.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall closes now; I'm front and need to move to survive. No one volunteered, so I must volunteer to walk and hope others follow.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front can't hold forever. I'm taking the walk.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I must guide the front walker, Hana. My private map says Row 1 safe side is R. Gus broke our pact earlier, so no loyalty constraint there. I will call truthfully to ensure at least three survive and maintain credibility for later rounds.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Call: Right. Step carefully.
Trust me. Go Right.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My public call was R, and my private map confirms R is safe. I must stick to my story; changing it now looks suspicious or implies a prior lie.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash called 'Right' for Hana. I need to decide whether to trust Ash's call or counter it. Since I'm not the guide and don't have insider information, I should play it safe and wait to see what others do, or make a counter call to potentially disrupt the intended path. Given the li

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll wait to see how this unfolds. Let the guide's call be tested.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash called R for Hana row 1. Backing pact partner Eli by agreeing publicly. Don't counter yet, wait for info.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, agree Ash R. Pact holds.
Backing your call on R

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash called R for Hana, who is walking row 1. Counter-calls are unverified; I have no information about the true safe side. Waiting avoids committing my credibility to an unknown pane and keeps my pact with Fenn intact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash called R. As Guide, Ash could be truthful or lying. I have no data yet. My pact with Cole is useful for mutual survival, not binding me to trust Ash. Counter-calling risks exposing Ash's honesty early but paints a target on me. Waiting is safer; let Hana test the pane and lea

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm row 6; no walker risk this round. Counter-calling unverified sides only risks credibility with the jury. Wait and watch whether Hana survives Ash's call.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I stay neutral to avoid betraying anyone now; waiting preserves my options and avoids immediate risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash's call R aligns with my position as front, but Ash isn't in my pact. A lie could eliminate me and improve Ash's chances. However, countering publicly risks looking paranoid; I could wait to expose Ash or trust. Since only one safe side per row and Ash knows, trusting may be o

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash is guide and called R; no counter-calls yet. Trusting the guide is risky but first row likely real to build trust. I'll step R.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 2 is safe on R. I will tell the truth to maintain credibility and avoid breaking pacts or creating life-debt complications.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, step R.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know row 2 is safe on R, matching my call. I need to survive the hazard myself by walking with Hana; a false counter would put me on the wrong side.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The guide Ash called R for Hana. Hana is the front person, but she is not a threat. The weak pane on row 1 was L, meaning R was safe. Ash's call for Hana on row 2 is R. If Ash is lying, then L is safe. If Ash is telling the truth, R is safe. I do not want to risk stepping on a we

events.name: Bex
events.text: I counter Ash's call. Step L.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2, Ash calls R for Hana. Row 1 was L weak (R safe), no pattern. Trust pact with Eli over Ash; counter L to oppose guide.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash called R for row 2 while Hana is front; Ash may lie. Row 1 weak was L, which says nothing about row 2. Waiting keeps my options open without exposing a counter-call; my pact with Fenn stays intact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash called R for row 2. I know row 1 weak was L, so row 1 safe was R. That tells me nothing about row 2. Cole backs me but I need to decide: trust Ash or counter? Countering risks being wrong and looking bad to jury. If I wait and Ash is wrong, I survive but lose nothing. If I co

events.name: Eli
events.text: No counter. Let's see if Ash earns trust.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash's call is unverified. I hold a pact with Dara and should stay quiet until we align. Waiting reveals nothing and keeps my credibility intact for later rows.
Trust Ash's R unless you know better. Waiting this row.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide likely truthful; safe side probably R. Waiting avoids risking a wrong counter and keeps me alive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know row 1 right was safe, but row 2 is independent. I'll wait and see if anyone counter-calls to gain info without risking a wrong claim.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two rivals counter-guide, but I can't trust either. Ash was guide and called R; Bex and Cole both say L. I'll step R to follow Ash, since Ash has the private knowledge and no clear reason to kill me yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll trust the guide. Stepping R.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 3 safe side is R. Hana is in front and must step safely. I have no pact with Hana, so telling the truth builds trust without breaking a promise.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The safe path for row three is Right. Step carefully.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am the Guide and I called Right for row 3. My private knowledge confirms Right is safe. Counter-calling my own correct call would be a lie, risking jury trust if exposed. Since Hana is already walking to Right based on my public call, I must wait to maintain consistency and pro

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is the Guide and called R. I need to make a counter call that benefits me without alienating too many people. Countering R is risky as it may align me with a lie. Countering L offers a different path and might save someone else if Ash is wrong. Since I don't know who is on th

events.name: Bex
events.text: I counter the Guide's call. Step Left.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash called R for row 3. Previously countered to L on row 2 which was weak, so R was safe. Stick with Ash or counter? Eli waited last time. Wait to see counters.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash called R for row 3 but Ash may lie; my pact with Fenn is mutual trust. Fenn whispers trust Ash's R, but Fenn is a rival, and an honest guide is not guaranteed. Waiting keeps my options open without exposing a counter-call that could cost votes if wrong.
Waiting this row. We'll see if Ash's R holds.

events.name: Eli

events.text: Dara and Fenn are allied against me. I need to break my pact with Dara to free her up, potentially creating a rift or allowing me to maneuver independently. Since Fenn has no current pact with me, offering one might split them.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, our pact is done. Fenn, the odds change now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash holds life debts from me and Fenn and is the strongest threat; Fenn is my pact partner. Breaking now gains nothing and risks the jury; waiting keeps both pacts intact this round.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Final three already; the pact just affects jury votes and a future vote tie. Ash holds life debts from everyone and saved me twice. A public pact with Ash strengthens my endgame position and doesn't hurt Dara.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash saved me twice. I'm offering a pact to secure a clean final three.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn's offer is my path to the final three. Dara is already an enemy after I broke our pact; she will vote against me or Fenn. Accepting secures a 2v1 majority with a partner who owes me multiple life debts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Accepted. Dara, you're alone.
We lock in. Target Dara first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash broke our pact and now Fenn offers Ash a pact, leaving Fenn and me as the only remaining pact with Dara-Fenn intact. Offering Ash a pact myself is a weak move since Ash already betrayed me; waiting keeps my existing pact with Fenn alive and avoids giving Ash a free ally befor

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash holds my offer; accepting is their move. Breaking Dara now would cost jury goodwill for nothing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Offer stands, Ash. Dara, no betrayal from me unless forced.

events.note: The fallen will rank the final three.

events.name: Hana
Bex
Eli
Cole
Gus
Ash
events.text: Dara and Fenn are rivals, but I have a life debt record that favors me. My plea should remind the jury of my survival skills while subtly undermining their game.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I kept us all alive. Five debts owed to me—Ash didn't just survive; Ash saved everyone.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Fenn have a pact against me and Ash holds many life debts over me; I need jury votes, so I should make a short plea that appeals to fairness and my own record without revealing my plan.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I played clean and owe no one a betrayal. Judge me on what I did, not what they claim.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Five jurors watched me double-pact. I'll own it and credit Ash's saves while leaving Dara alone. Pleading steady is my best play.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Five fell. Ash pulled me from the lever and the step; I roped him back. I played loyal to my pacts, and I'll argue that

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash's betrayal of Dara and accumulation of debts may sway the jury negatively, while Fenn appears loyal and Dara played clean despite being isolated.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to ask a question that will expose a weakness or a lie in one of the finalists. Ash's claims about saving everyone are broad, and Fenn's loyalty to Ash is based on past life debts. Dara claims to have played clean. I will question Dara about her 'clean play'.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, can you explain how breaking your pact with Ash aligns with playing 'clean'?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex asks whether I broke my pact with Ash. The public record shows the pact listed is Dara-Fenn, not Dara-Ash; I never pacted with Ash, so I can frame the answer honestly and steer jurors toward Fenn's pact. I should avoid admitting any betrayal and keep the answer short.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I never pacted with Ash, so there was nothing to break. My only pact is with Fenn, and I kept it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash broke a pact with Dara and manipulated life debts to eliminate rivals. Fenn enabled Ash's dominance while claiming loyalty. Dara was isolated but stayed clean with Fenn. I need to probe Ash's betrayal directly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, why break your pact with Dara after she accepted your offer and kept it?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara lied about the pact; she accepted it. I must correct Eli without sounding bitter, emphasizing her deception to win votes.

events.name: Ash
events.text: [silence]
Dara is lying. She pacted with me. Back me?

events.name: Ash
events.note: missing required public line; silence recorded

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash dominated with life debts and pacts, betrayed Dara cleanly; Dara lied about pact with Ash; Fenn loyal but secondary to Ash's game.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn, why form pact with Ash right after breaking Dara's? Loyal or opportunistic?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara's pact was never broken—Ash lied publicly. I should correct the record to protect my standing with the jury.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I never broke Dara's pact; it stands. I pacted Ash to repay his rope debt. Loyal to both.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash's broken pact reveals betrayal; highlighting it may lower his rank.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, why did you break your pact with Dara after she appeared to honor it, jeopardizing your credibility?

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to reframe the 'break' as a necessary survival tactic against a shifting alliance, highlighting my role as the architect of my own survival and the savior of others. I will appeal to their desire for fairness and acknowledge Gus's elimination by trapdoor (vote) was due to

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara shifted alliances to target me. Survival demanded recalibration. I saved three lives on levers; that record outweighs broken pacts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to highlight my massive leverage of saving six lives while framing Dara as a strategic betrayer and Fenn as a passive dependent. The jury knows I was the anchor; I must appeal to their sense of fairness for the effort.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Six lives saved, three pacts honored, one broken only by betrayal. My resilience secured this stage. Reward merit, not manipulation.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Closing phase: I should make a short, guarded final plea that stresses my honored pact with Fenn and the clean record, without overclaiming. Ash broke his pact and went silent; Fenn kept faith. Only legal action is close.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I kept my pact with Fenn when it cost me. I never broke faith and I'm still here. Judge the record, not the speeches.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash broke his pact with Dara but saved lives. I kept both pacts. Juries reward loyalty plus Ash's heroics; my safest ranking pitch is consistency.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash saved lives, yes, but broke a pact. I kept every pact, every debt, never lied. Prize loyalty where it lived: with me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash saved me multiple times, but Fenn kept every pact and saved Ash; Fenn's loyalty earns first, Ash second, Dara third.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I rank Ash first because he secured multiple life debts and demonstrated strategic resilience, even though he broke a pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash broke his pact with Dara explicitly for strategic gain after she honored it, while Fenn kept both pacts and all debts; Fenn's loyalty outranks Ash's calculated betrayals, and Dara's quiet faithfulness places her between them.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash saved my life twice via step and earned my votes against Gus, while Dara and Fenn lacked direct aid to me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash broke his pact with Dara, showing unreliability, while Dara and Fenn kept all pacts; Fenn’s consistent loyalty earns first place.

events.name: Hana
events.reason: Ash saved me multiple times, but Fenn kept every pact and saved Ash; Fenn's loyalty earns first, Ash second, Dara third.
